{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Composite 1", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high operating leverage and low book-to-market ratio tend to have higher returns due to their high growth potential and low risk of default.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OPLeverage"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24}, 

{"name": "Composite 2", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high Research and Development expenses and high Idiosyncratic risk tend to have higher returns due to their innovative products and high potential for growth.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18}, 

{"name": "Composite 3", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high Tangibility and low Leverage tend to have higher returns due to their low risk of default and high potential for growth.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "tang"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Leverage"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "STreversal", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30}, 

{"name": "Composite 4", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high Analyst Optimism and low Short Interest tend to have higher returns due to their high growth potential and low risk of default.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AOP"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "ShortInterest"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 20}, 

{"name": "Composite 5", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high Operating Profitability and high Payout Yield tend to have higher returns due to their high growth potential and high dividend yield.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PayoutYield"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.95, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 15}, 

{"name": "Composite 6", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high Intangible Assets and low Book Leverage tend to have higher returns due to their high growth potential and low risk of default.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BPEBM"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 25}, 

{"name": "Composite 7", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high Earnings Consistency and low Idiosyncratic Volatility tend to have higher returns due to their low risk of default and high potential for growth.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "IdioVolAHT"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "MRreversal", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 28}, 

{"name": "Composite 8", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high Customer Momentum and low Illiquidity tend to have higher returns due to their high growth potential and low risk of default.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "CustomerMomentum"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Illiquidity"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18}
]}
